test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that represents the letters that, when sequentially placed from left to right in the blanks below, will complete the letter series.

_ M _ B A J M Q _ A _ M Q B _ J _ _ B _

options.text: J Q B J A M Q A
B Q A J M Q A B
A M B Q J M J Q
J A M M Q A B J

solution:
The logic followed here is:

Given Sequence: _ M _ B A J M Q _ A _ M Q B _ J _ _ B _

Now, putting the letters in the blank spaces given in the option one by one:

Option 1) J Q B J A M Q A → **__J__ M __Q__ B A / J M Q __B__ A / __J__ M Q B __A__ / J __M__ __Q__ B __A__**

'J M Q B A' are repeated.

Option 2) B Q A J M Q A B → **__B__** M __Q__ B A / J M Q __A__ A / __J__ M Q B __M__ / J __Q__ __A__ B __B__

Option 3) A M B Q J M J Q → __A__ M __M__ B A / J M Q __B__ A / __Q__ M Q B __J__ / J __M__ __J__ B __Q__

Option 4) J A M M Q A B J → __J__ M __A__ B A / J M Q __M__ A / __M__ M Q B __Q__ / J __A__ __B__ B __J__

Here, 'Option 1' followed a pattern.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
